reader.requirement: At 85 FUNCTION SUM returns the exact algebraic sum of all argument-1 values, over literals, numeric items of any usage/sign/scale, arithmetic expressions and ALL-subscripted tables (ODO bounded by its current object).

reader.notes: SumScaled adds scale-aligned Int128 values checked (size-escaped, never wrapped); IntrinsicResultType.Resolve selects Integer only when every argument is provably integer (IsIntegerOperand reads the literal FORM, the item's integer description, a nested call's resolved type), else Numeric, and the CHAR screen honours it. No edition switch on the value or type path. Witnesses g85_bf40_08 and 1989-RV-A_2_42_4-3 MATCH at 85.

refuter.evidence: rf1: SUM(NP 1) -> 101, SUM(NF 1) -> 1.009 (P scaling both sides), SUM(A A) - A with A=18 nines -> 999999999999999999 (19-digit intermediate kept exact), SUM(SQRT(4) 1) -> 3. rf11: SUM(A .000000000000000017) - A -> .000000000000000017. rf4 (rf4-001): SUM(numeric-edited item) refused COBOL1627 (class alphanumeric at 85, not numeric, §1989:A.2.42.3). rf5: SUM() refused (COBOL1504 and COBOL0900 empty list requires 2002). cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.42.4 RV1 'The returned value is the sum of the arguments'.
